device.description: A short reference to the device code, the same on its issue, approval or denial and expiry, so that they join up: 16 hex digits of a hash of the hash it is kept under. It opens nothing.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent the device sent when it asked for the code, with control and format characters dropped and cut to 128 characters: what the approval page showed the person.

requested_from.description: The address the device asked for the code from, as the deployment's proxies vouch for it: what the approval page showed the person. On an approval or a denial, whose own address is in the record's context.

expires_at.description: When the code stops being answerable: ten minutes after it was issued.
